signal.direction: LONG iff EMA3>EMA12; SHORT iff EMA3<EMA12; equality emits no signal
signal.fill: entry at next completed bar open; long at ASK and short at BID
signal.managed_exit: TP, opposite-signal and giveback are evaluated only after a completed close and execute at the next available bar open; fixed max-age executes at its precommitted final bar close

portfolio.jpy_conversion: JPY-quoted PnL is direct; USD-quoted PnL uses the latest completed USD_JPY mid close at or before each exit
portfolio.margin_model: none; fixed-unit accounting continues through zero and negative equity, which is retained as failure evidence and is not a tradable-capital claim

costs.raw: mid prices, zero spread and slippage

configs.tp: per-pair tuning directional executable maximum completed-close excursion Q40 over a full 24-bar horizon wholly inside tuning, floored at 1.25 times tuning median observed roundtrip spread cost; frozen for walk-forward

selection.lcb_proxy: UTC-day-cluster mean minus Bonferroni two-sided 5pct family critical value times cluster standard error across the 12 frozen configs

admission_gates.family_correction: 12-config Bonferroni-adjusted UTC-day-cluster LCB plus all gates conjunctive

changes: bound TP estimation to full horizons wholly inside tuning
moved completed-close dependent exits to the next executable bar open
removed synthetic TP-time midpoint reconstruction from bar-close spread
changed drawdown to a completed-bar portfolio mark-to-market curve
changed monthly multiples to consecutive month-end equity ratios
added equity-ruin and family-adjusted LCB admission gates
selected configs with EXECUTABLE_BASE only; ADVERSE_STRESS remains evaluation-only
